tasks.label: Smoke test GET / and /app
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $base = 'http://127.0.0.1:3000'; try { Write-Host 'GET /'; $r1 = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$base/" -Headers @{ 'Accept' = 'text/html' } -Method GET; Write-Host ("/ status: {0}" -f $r1.StatusCode); } catch { Write-Host ("/ failed: {0}" -f $_.Exception.Message) }; try { Write-Host 'GET /app'; $r2 = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$base/app" -Headers @{ 'Accept' = 'text/html' } -Method GET -MaximumRedirection 0 -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host ("/app status: {0}" -f $r2.StatusCode); } catch { if ($_.Exception.Response -ne $null) { $code = $_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__; $loc = $_.Exception.Response.Headers['Location']; Write-Host ("/app redirected: {0} -> {1}" -f $code, $loc); } else { Write-Host ("/app failed: {0}" -f $_.Exception.Message) } }
